Title: Generally Available: Azure Ultra Disk Storage is Now Available in New Zealand North

Body.Content:
Azure Ultra Disk Storage is now available in New Zealand North. Azure Ultra Disk Storage offers high throughput, high IOPS, and consistent low latency disk storage for Azure virtual machines (VMs). Ultra Disk Storage is suited for data-intensive workloads such as SAP HANA, top-tier databases, and transaction-heavy workloads.  

Learn more.
